entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Hey, you're not lying to me, are you?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: You really do know the members of[n]the Phantom Thieves, right?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: If that's true... Then you must have some[n]inside info that I don't know about, right?
This question will affect Shinya's trust[n]in me. I have to answer it correctly!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: No way! Really!? That's some great[n]insider info, [lName]-san!
I was somehow able to maintain[n]his trust!

entries.speaker: Shinya

entries.speaker: Shinya

entries.speaker: Shinya

Shinya is starting to lose trust in me...
I have to regain his trust...
